description: Na₆BaO₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/nmc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent BaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one BaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.65 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent BaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.32 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form BaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with sixteen NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. All Ba-O bond lengths are 2.54 Å. O is bonded to six Na and one Ba atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OBaNa₆ pentagonal bipyramids.
